name: Sender
description_en:
Sender combines email campaigns, subscriber groups, forms and automation workflows, with separate transactional sending controls. Its Free Forever plan includes email automation, while some multichannel and resend features require paid plans. A temporary Professional trial is distinct from the continuing Free allowance.

A useful evaluation follows a migrated subscriber from field mapping to group entry and a welcome email, then checks both workflow processing and available capacity. This profile focuses on those documented operations and their failure boundaries. It does not execute an import, activate a workflow or measure delivery.
description_zh:
Sender 结合邮件活动、订阅者群组、表单及自动化流程，并为事务发送提供独立控制。Free Forever 包含邮件自动化，一些多渠道及重发功能需要付费。临时 Professional 试用与持续 Free 额度不同。

评估可沿迁移订阅者的字段映射、群组进入及欢迎邮件，检查流程处理与剩余容量。本文聚焦这些文档操作及失败边界，未执行导入、启用流程或测量投递。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure a single entry trigger with repeat-entry controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置单个入口触发器及重复进入控制。

core_features.explanation_en: Import contacts without triggering active group automations when the option is unchecked.
core_features.explanation_zh: 不勾选触发选项时，导入不会运行活跃群组自动化。

core_features.explanation_en: Use email workflows while checking paid SMS/resend entitlements.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用邮件流程，同时核对付费短信／重发权限。

core_features.explanation_en: Send with the appropriate credentials and inspect message events in logs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用对应凭据发送，并在日志检查消息事件。

en: Migrate a historical newsletter list without re-triggering its welcome.
Build a controlled group-entry journey and monitor active/unique recipients.
zh: 迁移历史简报列表并避免再次触发欢迎。
建立受控群组进入路径，监控活跃／唯一收件人。

sections.title_en: Import the audience without replaying its welcome series
sections.title_zh: 导入受众时避免重放欢迎系列
sections.en:
The import guide’s Organize step places every row into every selected group. Leaving Trigger active automations upon import unchecked suppresses active automation entry for that import; checking it can run matching group-triggered workflows. For a historical newsletter migration, make that choice before starting the job.

Cancellation is partial: already processed subscribers stay. Review the results report, correct affected rows and verify a representative record. The guide also says old engagement history and automation positions do not transfer. Rebuilding a journey is not a continuation of the old platform’s in-flight state.
sections.zh:
导入指南的 Organize 步骤会将每行加入所有选定群组。不勾选 Trigger active automations upon import 时，该次导入不进入活跃自动化；勾选则可能运行符合的群组触发流程。历史简报迁移应在任务开始前明确选择。

取消只有部分效果，已处理订阅者仍保留。需查看结果报告、修正问题行并验证代表性记录。指南还说明旧互动历史及自动化位置不会迁移。重建路径不是延续旧平台进行中状态。

sections.title_en: One entry event and repeat permission are separate choices
sections.title_zh: 入口事件与重复权限分别选择
sections.en:
Every Sender workflow has one trigger block. Documented choices include group changes, dates, specific link clicks, purchases and field/status updates. The Repeat workflow toggle controls whether the same contact can enter again after a new qualifying event; disabling it limits entry to once.

For a welcome, select the intended group and test a new join. Updating trigger settings applies to future entrants, while existing contacts retain the logic applicable when they entered. The guide does not make saving equivalent to activation: the workflow remains Draft until explicitly enabled. Use separate workflows when responding to different trigger types.
sections.zh:
每个 Sender 流程只有一个触发块。文档选项包括群组变化、日期、指定链接点击、购买及字段／状态更新。Repeat workflow 控制同一人在新的合格事件后能否再次进入；关闭则仅一次。

欢迎流程应选择目标群组并测试一次新加入。更新触发设置影响未来进入者，现有人保留进入时的逻辑。指南并未将保存等同启用，流程在明确启用前仍为 Draft。响应不同事件类型时需用独立流程。

sections.title_en: Draft is also the deactivated state
sections.en:
Sender documents Active and Draft, with no separate Paused status. Deactivation returns a workflow to Draft, blocks new entry and stops pending steps for contacts already inside. The workflow structure and historical data remain. Reactivation accepts qualifying new entrants again.

Before editing a live welcome, note where existing contacts are waiting. The page confirms stopping pending processing but does not fully specify catch-up timing for every delayed contact after reactivation. Verify that case with controlled addresses rather than promising that messages resume with unchanged spacing. Incomplete required steps prevent activation.
sections.zh:
Sender 文档采用 Active 与 Draft，没有独立 Paused 状态。停用会回到 Draft，阻止新人并停止现有人待处理步骤；结构及历史数据保留。重新启用后再接受符合条件的新人。

编辑活跃欢迎流程前，应记录现有人等待位置。页面确认停止待处理，但未完整规定重新启用后每种延迟联系人的补发时机。需用受控地址验证，不能承诺原间隔不变地恢复。必需步骤未完成会阻止启用。

sections.title_en: Deleting today’s audience does not create fresh monthly capacity
sections.title_zh: 删除当前受众不会产生新的月容量
sections.en:
The audience guide separates active subscribers from unique addresses emailed during the billing period. Active excludes unsubscribed, bounced and spam-reporting contacts and recalculates hourly. The unique-sent count includes addresses later deleted, bounced or unsubscribed and resets monthly. Both must fit the plan.

For an illustrative 2,500-subscriber allowance, sending to one full cohort and replacing it with a different full cohort is not a fresh 2,500-recipient budget. Inspect both counters and total sends before scheduling the second group. Remaining message credits alone do not prove the next audience is permitted.
sections.zh:
受众指南区分活跃订阅者与计费期内已发送的唯一地址。活跃排除退订、退信及举报垃圾邮件者，每小时重算；唯一已发送数包括后来删除、退信或退订的地址，每月重置。两者都必须符合套餐。

假设额度为 2,500 人，给完整一批发送后替换成另一批，不会产生新的 2,500 人预算。安排第二组前需检查两个计数及总发送量。仍有消息额度，不足以证明下一受众可以发送。

sections.title_en: Unlimited workflows still consume a limited sending pool
sections.title_zh: 不限流程仍消耗有限发送池
sections.en:
The automation-plan guide includes email workflows, splits, dynamic content and unlimited steps across plans. SMS automation requires Professional or Enterprise; non-opener auto-resend starts at Standard. Campaign and automation messages share the monthly allowance. Standard provides 12 times the subscriber tier and Professional 24 times; Free has 15,000 sends and 2,500 subscribers.

On downgrade, a workflow remains listed, but unsupported steps such as SMS do not execute. Do not interpret the saved canvas as an active entitlement. Check each channel after a plan change and investigate exhausted volume when an otherwise valid trigger produces no message.
sections.zh:
自动化套餐指南将邮件流程、分流、动态内容及不限步骤列入各档。短信自动化需要 Professional 或 Enterprise，未打开自动重发从 Standard 起。活动与自动化共用月额度；Standard 为订阅者档位十二倍，Professional 二十四倍，Free 为 15,000 封及 2,500 人。

降级后流程仍列出，但短信等不受支持步骤不执行。不能将保存的画布视为当前权限。更改套餐后需逐渠道核对，合格触发却无消息时也需检查额度耗尽。

sections.title_en: An API acceptance needs a log check
sections.title_zh: API 接受后仍需检查日志
sections.en:
Transactional sending requires enabled account access, a verified sender and either an API token or generated SMTP credentials. The guide distinguishes HTTP/JSON integration from SMTP configuration and recommends TLS for SMTP. A successful API response confirms acceptance for delivery.

For a password-reset test, use an address you control, then inspect Transactional emails → Logs for the recipient, subject and event status. Keep this application path distinct from a marketing-group welcome. This profile did not verify transactional rate limits, suppression interaction or retry/idempotency semantics and does not infer them from marketing automation allowances.
sections.zh:
事务发送需要账户已启用权限、已验证发送者，以及 API 令牌或生成的 SMTP 凭据。指南区分 HTTP／JSON 集成与 SMTP 配置，并建议 SMTP 使用 TLS。API 成功响应只确认接受以待投递。

密码重置测试需用自己控制的地址，再到 Transactional emails → Logs 核对收件人、主题及事件状态。应与营销群组欢迎路径区分。本文未核实事务速率、抑制关系或重试／幂等语义，也不从营销自动化额度推导。

sections.title_en: Separate the permanent free plan, trial and credits
sections.title_zh: 区分持续免费、试用及积分
sections.en:
The price page offers Free Forever at 2,500 subscribers/15,000 monthly emails and automatically adds a 14-day Professional trial that ends back on Free without a credit card. Free carries branding. The credits guide describes one credit per email without an expiry or subscriber limit; paid totals did not render in the pricing read, so they remain unquoted. VAT is excluded.

The page explicitly lists English, Lithuanian, Polish and Spanish interfaces; this is a vendor statement, not a hands-on localization check. Sender merits evaluation for an operator who can manage audience counters, migration controls and plan-specific steps. Verify the actual quote and account conditions before committing.
sections.zh:
价格页提供 Free Forever：2,500 人／每月 15,000 封，并自动附十四天 Professional 试用，无需信用卡，到期回到 Free。免费版含品牌标识。积分指南说明每封一个积分，无有效期或订阅者上限；本次价格读取未呈现付费总额，因此不报价。VAT 不含。

页面明确列出英语、立陶宛语、波兰语及西班牙语界面；这是厂商说明，非上手本地化检查。能管理受众计数、迁移控制及套餐步骤的运营者可评估 Sender。采用前需确认真实报价及账户条件。
